review:
A comic-book Egypt starring Khonsu, the moon god, on the Merge Up mechanic with 4,096 ways. Symbols merge into higher ones as they win.

In Free Spins and Super Free Spins, a progress bar gives symbols Split or Wild powers. The buy menu is huge: Chance x5 or x10 to make the bonus far more likely, regular or Super Free Spins, or a random feature. Very high volatility, 10,000x max and 97.01% RTP. Free spins about once every 162 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.01% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
